drhp.business: Kokuyo Camlin Limited manufactures, develops and markets stationery and art materials — writing instruments, notebooks and paper products, office stationery, and art and creative supplies — serving students, professionals and creative users through a pan-India distribution network and exports to 26 countries. The Company's evolution has been shaped by its 2011 strategic partnership with Kokuyo Co., Ltd. of Japan, combining domestic brand legacy with global design expertise.
drhp.end_markets: Pan-India retail, schools, government institutions and MSMEs|Export markets in 26 countries (2.97% of turnover)

risks.note: Evolving consumer behaviour driven by digital adoption and lifestyle changes may impact demand for traditional stationery and art products.
Variability in global supply chains and inflationary pressures, including geopolitical disruptions, may result in increased input costs, affecting margins.
Sales performance is influenced by academic cycles and festive periods, resulting in seasonal fluctuations in demand.
Sustaining brand resonance among younger and digitally engaged consumers remains essential in a competitive environment.
Changes in education policies, trade regulations, and environmental norms may impact compliance requirements and operational processes.
Intense competition from domestic stationery brands may impact market share, pricing power, and margins.

The statutory auditors issued a modified (qualified) opinion after management identified discrepancies between the physical quantity recorded in the books and the physical inventory in the prior year (an expense including indirect taxes of Rs 2,356.81 lakhs was recognised); the possible impact on prior-period comparability could not be determined, affecting comparability of the current year's figures.
